ValidationRule.description: Keeps billing separate from posting and requires the final demo reference.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Receipt", OR(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Billing_Status__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(Demo_Invoice_Reference__c))) ), AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Consumption", OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Billing_Status__c)), AND( ISNEW(), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Billing_Status__c, "Not Ready")) ), AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Billing_Status__c), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Posting_Status__c), "Posted Usage")), NOT(OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Billing_Status__c), "Not Ready"), ISPICKVAL(Billing_Status__c, "Ready to Bill")), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Billing_Status__c), "Ready to Bill"), ISPICKVAL(Billing_Status__c, "Billed (Demo)")) )) ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Billing_Status__c, "Billed (Demo)"), LEN(TRIM(Demo_Invoice_Reference__c)) = 0 ), AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Billing_Status__c, "Billed (Demo)")), NOT(ISBLANK(Demo_Invoice_Reference__c)) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Post the usage before changing billing. Advance to Ready to Bill, then enter a fictional invoice reference when marking Billed (Demo).
